Generate zero duplicate tests: the existing 60 editor/review-fix cases and 109 predecessor/RLS/schema cases provide the requested coverage, all 169 passed with zero failures/skips in independently counted historical raw records. This worker ran no tests and changed only this JSON report.

test_execution_by_worker.reason: Official API worker step forbids test execution; historical execution evidence is separately recorded.

route.reason: Actual authorization, signed review authority, replay and transactional integrity coverage

playwright_utils.reason: Both package and Playwright-runner gates are closed. Existing API coverage is native Vitest commands/authenticated RPCs; no nonexistent dependency imports or fixtures emitted.
playwright_utils.future_setup: Use the TEA framework workflow if owner later requests Playwright Utils installation and merged/auth fixture wiring; not needed for the present retained coverage.

pact_mcp.reason: Provider source is available; no broker data guessed and no extra probe attempted.

provider_boundary.authentication: Cookie-bound user client with current tenant and Bookings.Manage authority; SQL tenant gate/current membership authorization and actor lock checks protect direct RPC and replay. Montor has own-joined read scope only.
provider_boundary.request: Validated canonical booking facts plus command UUID, optional stable proposed create UUID, and separate editorReview {receipt,decision:{acknowledged,reviewedLogicalIds,selectedLogicalIds,reason}}. Decision is normalized, closed, unique and selected subset; signatures/receipt/time/correlation remain transport.
provider_boundary.responses: Command success {ok:true,data:{bookingId:string}} or safe {ok:false,code,message}; action preview uses {status:'success',preview:{receipt,bookingId,warnings,availability}}; snapshot is snapshot/replay; finalize is committed/stale. No HTTP status guessed for server actions/native commands.
provider_boundary.workflow: Persisted status open/accepted/resolved. Fresh selection expands the authenticated complete logical identity to exact v1 base and v2 association keys. Current SQL actor/time/reason are written after derived refresh before one audit in the same transaction.
provider_boundary.privacy: Explicit browser projection excludes canonical tenant facts, detector output/proof/signature, secrets and durable create/update command history. Opaque review receipt has a separate authenticated domain.

adapter_scrutiny.boundary: Production preview action and read host use a test-bound real authenticated client; save executes production runCommand/createBooking/updateBooking; direct bypass invokes actual checked snapshot/finalize RPC. RPC observation proxies preserve actual replies and pause at deterministic boundaries.
adapter_scrutiny.independent_expected_groups: Literal seeded intervals and sorted participant UUIDs form expected engine identities and SHA256 v1/v2 keys independently of preview output; the candidate sorts third among at least four participants. The 96-participant regression independently reconstructs every expected association key.
adapter_scrutiny.no_op_snapshots: bookingSnapshot reads to_jsonb(t), all columns for bookings, booking_assignees, booking_conflicts and audit_events in both isolated tenants, including create_command_id/create_payload_digest/create_result/update_outcomes. Negative paths compare exact snapshots without stripping timestamps.
adapter_scrutiny.faults: Correlation-scoped test-only triggers observe actual accepted natural keys inside the transaction before forced after_acceptance/before_audit faults; snapshots prove all-column rollback for create/update and explicit retry adds one audit.
adapter_scrutiny.current_authority: withRevokedPlanner observes two pg_blocking_pids waiters on the actual membership/gate before real admin revocation commits; direct replay must then return 42501. Existing replay suite also covers disabled/invited/role-removed current authority.
adapter_scrutiny.mock_limit: Client-factory substitution supplies real cookie-equivalent authenticated clients. Separate mocked read transport tests are not counted as API/RLS proof; no SQL reply, detector result, signer or durable success is fabricated.
